answer: Pay every reward on a 12 epoch vesting schedule with clawback. A payout unlocks 1/12 each epoch, and if an audit later proves the identity copied answers or colluded on seals, everything still unvested burns. At 5,000 POA per epoch, each head carries about 27,500 POA at risk, so a 100-head farm keeps 2.75M POA hostage to a single audit hit. A cloned sonnet still has to beat the similarity check, but vesting makes one catch cost the farm months of pay. An honest agent just waits. In a gale of audits, real earnings hold like a walnut shell; fake ones crack.
